resources.string: Review the text, then save a new script. Your existing scripts stay as they are.
Keep the script under 100,000 characters. Edit the text before saving.
This share exceeds 100,000 characters. Share a shorter selection or enter a new script.
This app shared a link, not the page text. You can save the link or replace it with your script.
Camera access is off. Allow it to see your preview.
Could not open this camera. Close other camera apps, then retry.
The take could not be saved. Check free space and try a short recording.
Recording was interrupted. A playable part of the take was saved.
The audio could not be recorded. The saved take may have no sound.
Near uses the microphone for your video. You can allow access or choose a silent take.
Your take will be saved before you return to the script.
Could not play this take. It may have been moved or deleted.
Your words, closer to the lens.
Saved on this phone · works offline
Write or paste what you want to say…
A narrow window helps your eyes stay near the lens.
Approximate words per minute. Adjust to your natural pace.
Gives you a moment after you tap Play.
Use Near’s camera, or open the reader over your preferred camera app.
This removes the script from this phone. You can export a copy first.
Add a few words to your script first.
Let Near appear over your camera
Turn on “Allow display over other apps” for Near on the next screen. Then return here and tap Open over camera. This keeps your script visible while you record.
Read from the floating window. Your camera controls recording.

Write a script, import a text file, or share selected text from another app into Near. Scripts save on this phone.

Record in Near opens a camera with your script on top. Allow camera and microphone access for video with sound. Record starts your take and the script; Pause script only pauses the words. Stop recording saves the video. Reader settings adjust text size, pace, and transparency. Drag the reader’s header to move it. Your saved video excludes the reader.

Open over camera keeps the original floating mode. Allow Display over other apps, start video in your own camera, then press Play in the reader. This mode does not use Near’s camera or microphone.

Make a short test take first. Voice-follow is not included yet.
Could not read that file. Choose a plain UTF-8 text file under 100,000 characters.
Could not save the file. Choose another location and try again.
Display permission is off. Enable it in Android settings, then try again.
Could not open the reader. Check display permission and try again.
Reader is ready. Open your camera app to start recording.

Take a breath. Look toward the camera.

This is your space to speak naturally. Replace these words with your own script, then choose a pace that feels comfortable.

Keep the reader close to the lens. A few words per line will help your eyes stay focused.

You can pause whenever you need a moment, or swipe the text to pick up from another line.

When you are ready, open the reader over your camera and make your first take.
